# Synthetic Pi-hole regex list (one regex per line, with Pi-hole's ;querytype= and ;invert
# options). Written for TelltaleDNS tests; not copied from any published list.
(^|\.)ads\.example\.com$
^ad([sxv]?[0-9]*|[0-9]+)[_.-]
^(.+[_.-])?telemetry[_.-]
^track(er|ing)?[0-9]*\.example\.(com|net|org)$
^[a-z0-9]{32}\.example\.net$
^abc\.example\.com$;querytype=AAAA
^metrics\.;querytype=A,AAAA
^ipv4-only\.example\.com$;querytype=!A
^(.*\.)?allowed\.example\.com$;invert
^semi;colon\.example\.com$
^reply\.example\.com$;reply=nxdomain

# rejected: the linear-time engine has no backreferences or lookaround
^(ab)\1\.example\.com$
^(?!good).*\.example\.com$
^unclosed(group
^x$;querytype=WRONG
